title: Black Marble HD Monthly Composite (TEST)
description: TEST COLLECTION -- not for production use. Exercises the dps-output-discover Lambda end to end: routing, relocation into ProgramData/, and the veda_discover DAG trigger. Discovers monthly composites only, from ProgramData/Blackmarble/TestHD/ on nasa-disasters-staging, seeded from ProgramData/Blackmarble/hd/. The prefix deliberately does NOT begin with 'hd': a future production config declaring the slash-less prefix ProgramData/Blackmarble/hd would otherwise claim every file in an hd* test folder as well as this one. The date group accepts both 202408 and 2024-08 because the real files use the unhyphenated form while every other monthly config in this repo captures the hyphenated one. Safe to delete once the pipeline is verified.
